headline: PL Capital identifies eight large‑cap stocks with up to 41% upside
hook: Up to 41% upside flagged for large‑caps
summary: PL Capital has highlighted eight large‑cap Indian stocks it expects to rise between 13.4% and 41.3%. The list includes Bharat Electronics Ltd and GE Vernova T&D India, whose target prices exceed current market levels. Revenue forecasts for these companies suggest strong growth in the coming years. The picks aim to guide investors seeking higher returns from large‑cap equities.
why_it_matters: Potential gains for Indian large‑cap investors

headline: Nomura says GE Vernova, Hitachi Energy, and CG Power will benefit from GEC-III
summary: Brokerage firm Nomura has highlighted GE Vernova T&D India, Hitachi Energy India, and CG Power as primary beneficiaries of the upcoming Green Energy Corridor Phase-III (GEC-III) project. The initiative focuses on grid integration and transmission infrastructure for renewable energy expansion across the country. These heavy electrical equipment makers are positioned to secure fresh orders as power transmission outlays scale up. Indian retail investors tracking capital goods and power infrastructure themes should note this structural tailwind.
whats_next: GEC-III project rollout and official order announcements
why_it_matters: Power equipment makers eye major orders from grid expansion.
winners_losers: Power equipment makers gain / thermal-only players unaffected
